company_profile.description: Pliant Therapeutics, Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, focuses on discovering and developing integrin-based therapeutics for the treatment of solid tumors. Pliant Therapeutics, Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, California.
